items.question: What is Champty?
items.answer: Champty is a SaaS platform for managing electronic shelf labels (ESL). It connects your POS and business systems to the physical displays in your store and manages everything in real time.

items.question: Does Champty sell hardware?
items.answer: No. Champty is a software platform that works with existing ESL tags. We're not locked to one manufacturer. Our system is hardware-agnostic.

items.question: How does real-time sync work?
items.answer: When a price or promotion changes in your system, Champty automatically renders the new label, encodes it for the hardware, and sends it wirelessly to the tag on the shelf. All within seconds.

items.question: Can I manage multiple stores?
items.answer: Yes. Champty lets you manage all your stores, zones, and displays from a single centralized dashboard.

items.question: What systems does Champty integrate with?
items.answer: Champty connects to POS systems, inventory management, and other business tools. Our integration layer ensures every change flows automatically to the displays.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. Contact us to schedule a demo and get started with a pilot program tailored to your business.
